note: Hugeicons: the 10 style pages of one icon library — /icons/<style> (solid-sharp, stroke-rounded, twotone-rounded, duotone-standard …), each browsing thousands of icons in that style. Individual glyphs are not URLs. /pricing, /packages, /react-icons, /figma-icon-library, /icon-font-generator, /faq/* are the product's own pages.
